# AuthKit

> Provider-agnostic authentication UI for .NET, with Supabase as the bundled provider.
> One contract, two SDKs: contracts/authkit.contract.json is normative and a parity test in each
> language fails the build if either side drifts.

## Guides

- [Customizing the UI (English)](https://carloshenriquecarniatto.github.io/AuthKit/customization/): three levels — theme tokens, ak-* CSS classes, headless provider.
- [Personalizando a interface (Português)](https://carloshenriquecarniatto.github.io/AuthKit/personalizacao/)
- [Personalizar la interfaz (Español)](https://carloshenriquecarniatto.github.io/AuthKit/personalizacion/)
